Honestly, right now... today... it's just so hard to even say it out loud. But yes. I am. I don't have a... a specific, detailed plan, like I haven't written a note or gone out and bought anything, I haven't taken any actual steps like that. I haven't done anything to prepare. No, no, nothing like that. I mean, if I'm being completely honest, I rarely drink to begin with. Maybe half a glass of wine at a wedding or on New Year's Eve, but definitely not during that week.

Well, firearms, no. Mark and I don't own any guns. We've never been hunters or anything like that, and I've just never felt comfortable having one in the house, especially not with how my head has been lately. 

But medications... I mean, you have to understand, working as a senior vet tech, I literally hold the keys to the lockbox. I have access to absolutely everything. The heavy sedatives, the euthanasia solutions... it's my job to inventory them. But honestly, I could never do it that way. I've been present for so many euthanasias with animals, helping families say goodbye, and even though it's peaceful for the pets, the thought of taking something from the clinic... it just feels like a massive violation of the trust they put in me.
